$comment: Committed performance baseline. `npm run size` compares the built artifact
against the thresholds below and fails when the hard limit is exceeded.
Raising a threshold is allowed, but it must be its own commit with a written
justification, so that growth is visible in review rather than invisible in a
diff. Lowering a threshold after a size reduction is encouraged: the budget is
a ratchet.
Reproduce with:
npm ci && npm run build
npm run size
Note: gzip byte counts come from Node's zlib at level 9, which is what
scripts/size-check.js uses. The gzip(1) CLI at -9 produces a slightly
different figure because of header and dictionary differences. Compare like
with like.

measured.$comment: Canonical npm build (esbuild), measured with npm run size on Node 24.

previous.$comment: Artifact recorded before the Companion integration work (per-profile request limits, traffic accumulator, clean-IP management, mode switching, subscription-address routes).

$comment: 2026-09-01 Companion integration: hard limits move to 585,000 raw / 315,000 gzip and warn thresholds to 575,000 / 305,000. The measured artifact is 577,724 raw / 308,903 gzip, +16,156 raw / +13,115 gzip over the previous record. The growth is the Companion contract surface, not dependencies: per-profile request limits with their exhausted status and counter reset, the traffic accumulator and its 24-hour metrics, clean-IP management, mode switching, the subscription-address route and the batch scanner apply. It was paid down slightly in the same window: the welcome dialog that opened on every visit is gone, and its four setup steps are now an inline collapsible section in the overview. At 308,903 gzip bytes the artifact is 9.8% of Cloudflare's 3 MiB compressed script limit, so the platform constraint is still far away; the ratchet stands and the next increase needs its own justification here.

2026-08-07 final production polish: hard limits move to 575,000 raw / 305,000 gzip and warn thresholds to 560,000 / 295,000. The committed fallback artifact is 561,568 raw / 295,788 gzip and includes complete workspace themes, two-language rendering, operational diagnostics, Smart Setup handoff actions, denser overview/subscription analytics, accessible sortable client data, interaction/focus/reduced-motion states, and responsive navigation refinements. The sandbox could not install Terser/html-minifier/esbuild, so the directly deployable artifact is intentionally a conservative upper bound; the canonical npm build should be smaller. At 295,788 gzip bytes it remains under 9.5% of Cloudflare’s 3 MiB compressed script limit. No backend, auth, secret, Worker naming, deployment, configuration-generation, or scanner architecture was replaced.

2026-08-06 product quality refinement: hard limits move from 510,000/258,000 to 518,000/263,000 and warn thresholds to 510,000/258,000. The measured increase is 7,752 raw / 5,020 gzip bytes over the recorded hardened artifact. It pays for the fifth explained Streaming preset, direct overview routing, concurrent Smart Setup with a staged-review handoff, actionable diagnostic impact/recommendation blocks, the explicit Clean IP measure-select-apply journey, and mobile density/safe-area corrections. No backend, authentication, secret, naming, or deployment security code was replaced. At 258,081 gzip bytes the artifact remains about 8.2% of Cloudflare's 3 MiB compressed limit.

2026-08-06 product polish: hard limits move from 500,000/249,000 to 510,000/258,000. The increase is deliberate product code, not dependency growth: the panel now turns existing measurement services into four actionable diagnostics areas, runs and explains Smart Setup's live tests, stages reviewed presets, makes scanner selection/apply/save explicit, and gives subscriptions/settings complete mobile navigation. Superseded UI code was removed first. At 253,061 gzip bytes the Worker is 8.0% of Cloudflare's 3 MiB compressed limit; the new hard limit leaves less than 2% headroom and preserves the ratchet.

v1.0.0: warn thresholds raised from 482,000/240,000 to 492,000/245,000 and the hard limits from 492,000/244,000 to 500,000/249,000. Justification: the client-compatibility translation layer and the mobile navigation sheet are both load-bearing for the release (a config that no client accepts and two views unreachable on a phone), and the previous warn band had already been spent by v1.1. The artifact is at 7.7% of Cloudflare's 3 MiB compressed limit. The ratchet is intact: the next increase needs its own justification here.
Limits unchanged. The reduction recorded as (c) in the previous note was taken.
Both icon fonts are gone: the panel's 37-glyph woff2 subset cost 6,414 gzipped bytes
and proxy-ip's cost 1,542, replaced by inline SVG outlines extracted from those exact
subsets (scripts/extract-glyphs.py, whose docstring records the measurement that chose
the coordinate grid). The outlines cost 4,535 and 384, so the net saving is 3,037
gzipped bytes across 62 markup sites and three runtime glyph assignments.
That paid for the shared-subscription-link screen and its three routes, which landed in
the same window. Net against the previous baseline: +2,628 raw and +1,033 gzip, both
inside the limits raised for the previous pass rather than needing new ones. `font-src`
went to 'none' with the fonts, which the size work paid for incidentally.
Both figures sit above the warn thresholds and below the hard limits. That is the
intended state of a ratchet that has been spent: warn is where somebody should look.
Remaining measured reductions, in gzip bytes:
(a) SOURCE_CONTENT as plain script text instead of gzip+base64 saves 351 bytes. The
script already appears once in the file and gzip's 32 KB window cannot deduplicate
a copy 230 KB away, so the saving is the base64 tax alone. It is now the largest
single line item at 77,408 gzipped, but it is the self-update payload, so shrinking
it further means changing what `panel/update` ships.
(b) A PNG-compressed favicon comes out larger, not smaller. gzip already recovers the
21,928 base64 characters of the uncompressed BMP-in-ICO to 2,837 bytes, and PNG
data would be incompressible.
(c) Done: the icon fonts, above.
The artifact is at 7.7% of Cloudflare's 3 MiB compressed script limit, so the platform
constraint remains far away; this ratchet exists to make growth visible, which it did.
Previous note, v1.1 device scanner: warn thresholds were raised from 460,000/226,000 as
the scanner, its measurement frame and the design-token unification landed.
Previous note, v1.0.0: limits were set ~8% above the measured artifact when the Deploy
to Cloudflare pass added runtime identity resolution and the first-run page.

context.$comment: Reference points that explain where the bytes are. Not enforced, but useful when a budget is hit.
context.jszipRemovedIn: It was 34.1% of the bundle for one call site building a 460-byte archive of short text files; src/cores/zip.ts is a 265-line stored-entry ZIP writer that replaces it, with 16 tests that extract with the system unzip.
context.qrcodeGeneratorUsedBy: src/vendor/qrcode-generator.js, vendored; used by src/handlers/qrcode.ts only
context.joseUsedBy: tests only. src/auth/jwt.ts is a dependency-free HS256 implementation; `jose` is used by the auth tests as an independent reference implementation and lives in devDependencies. It is not imported by src/ and is not in the bundle.
context.padCodeNote: Deliberate signature resistance, not dead weight. Do not remove as an optimisation.
